title: Console entitlement channel, version 1
description: Plans the Console sends to AgentGate (commercial plan, phase 3). Requests are signed with audoryn-entitlements-v1 (see signing-vector.json and backend/app/application/console_entitlements.py). Routes, under /internal/console/entitlements/v1: POST /snapshots (scope entitlements.write, body: snapshot), POST /template (scope entitlements.write, body: template), GET /status?after=<organizationId>&limit=1..200 (scope entitlements.read). Every response is {version: 1, data} or {version: 1, error: {code, message}}; error codes: not_found (channel off), unauthorized, invalid, unknown_organization, rate_limited, unavailable.

entitlements.description: Named limits: true/false for a feature, a whole number of at least 0 for a limit. A name the plan does not give is 0 or not included (never unlimited).

planName.description: The plan's name as the Console shows it, for the workspace's Usage & billing page.

snapshot.description: One organisation's plan. AgentGate applies only a version higher than the one it holds; the same version answers already_applied, an older one stale. Versions start at 1 (0 is the new-workspace template AgentGate applied itself). When periodEnd passes and no newer snapshot arrived, AgentGate counts usage in the next period of the same length. Statuses trialing, active and past_due allow new work until validUntil (if given); paused, cancelled and expired do not.

template.description: The plan a new workspace starts on, applied the moment it is created. Usage resets every periodDays; it ends after validDays, or never when validDays is absent or null (the Free plan).

next.description: Pass as ?after= for the next page; null on the last page.

usage.description: This period's usage (the period AgentGate is counting in now).
